facts.fact: 晨光里他想起昨夜抓住她的那块地方。
facts.anchor: Somewhere out there was the spot where I'd caught my wife last night

facts.fact: 父亲的评价：你比我们都早知道哪里不对。
facts.anchor: You knew something was wrong before the rest of us did.

facts.fact: 父亲点明他做对了什么：没有把她丢给狼群。
facts.anchor: Instead of throwing her to the wolves

facts.fact: 他的自我认知：我一生都是 Blackwood 的武器、那个蛮汉。
facts.anchor: All my life, I’d been the Blackwood weapon. The brute.

facts.fact: 父亲的认可核心：你能带队。
facts.anchor: you proved something I always knew about you: you can lead.

facts.fact: 最重的一句：他不只看得上我的拳头，他看见了我。
facts.anchor: My dad didn't just value my fists. He saw me.

facts.fact: Ivar 的样子：站在三个哥哥的影子里，找自己的位置。
facts.anchor: Ivar didn’t look scared. He looked like a kid standing in the shadow of three older brothers

facts.fact: 他的教训：别人给你列的「你不能」，最后会变成你的极限。
他的决定：他跟我们一起去。
facts.anchor: "He's coming," I said, my voice absolute.
